You can follow these steps if you wanna verify.

1st - Click/tap here —> ⁠2│verify-your-asset 
2nd - Type the following (then hit enter on keyboard) —>  /verify add
3rd - Copy/paste your wallet address or ada handle and hit tab on keyboard
4th - You will be instructed to send a certain amount of ada to yourself. Send that exact amount to your wallet address from your same wallet address
5th - Wait until your wallet has confirmed transaction and you will see that you have been verified at ⁠2│verify-your-asset 
6th - Wait a bit longer and the roles that you have will show up

Note for non-OG members: If you have any rarity GTi but no Bubblejett -  your username will be BLACK. If you have any rarity Bubblejett your username will be RED.

How to verify your NFT address (for roles) 
Note: Your NFTs need to be in your wallet and not on the market for this to work.

1st - Click/tap here —> ⁠2│verify-your-asset 
2nd - Type the following (then hit enter on keyboard) —>  /verify add
3rd - Copy/paste your wallet address or ada handle and hit tab on keyboard
4th - You will be instructed to send a certain amount of ada to yourself. Send that exact amount to your wallet address from your same wallet address
5th - Wait until your wallet has confirmed transaction and you will see that you have been verified at ⁠2│verify-your-asset  
6th - Wait a bit longer and the roles that you have will show up

Note for non-OG members: If you have any rarity GTi but no Bubblejett -  your username will be BLACK. If you have any rarity Bubblejett your username will be RED.

If you click/tap on the profile pic, it will reveal your roles

I do think some are better suited for different things, but I always try to look at comparisons as objective as possible, so can't say I think Frostbite is overall better than the others, as it's more or less crafted for different things (just like most in-house engines). 

I used Unity for my Master's degree, Unreal 4/5 for hobby games/projects/level designs and a lot of Frostbite (what a surprise, right?) and, in my opinion, I like most of them, because they are great in different areas:
- Unity for quick game porotypes, as the programming language there is easier, but sucks big time for art stuff
- Unreal handles very well artistic stuff and level design, but it's a bit tricky to quickly prototype stuff because C++ is harder than Unity's C# and the "visual programming" takes some time to get used to
- Frostbite, well, not going to disclose it haha

I initially wanted to do something about robotics, but I also liked game dev so I started to learn (intensively) by myself in my first faculty year and by the end of that year, there were a few Game Jams (game development competitions where you have 24-48 straight hours in which you have to create some games based on a theme) and I said "Why not" and wanted to test my skills. One was organized my Microsoft, the second by Ubisoft and the third by EA and apparently I ended up winning all those lol and that really opened my eyes that I really have a knack for game developing. 

They all offered internships but I rejected them as I was still in my first Uni year and I wanted to have some more party time, but I eventually applied for internships in my 3rd year and the recruiters from EA still remembered me and that helped me a lot being accepted initially.

Overall, you can count the Gaming companies from Romania on one hand (only EA, Ubisoft and Gameloft here, and 2 other small studios) but I really liked it and tried my luck with this domain, even if it might cage me if I ever want to do something else (edited)

Nothing breaks a game faster but when morale is at an all time low.
This makes me think of the origin of the word "decimation" - (the killing of one in every ten of a group of people as a punishment for the whole group (originally with reference to a mutinous Roman legion where the romans lost a battle because of soldiers attitude).

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: ⁠2│verify-your-asset  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in ⁠2│verify-your-asset to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of ⁠2│verify-your-asset or simply come back to us in ⁠😅│general  and we will help you out.

If you want to verify your NFT(s)
⁠2│verify-your-asset 

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: ⁠2│verify-your-asset  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in ⁠2│verify-your-asset to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of ⁠2│verify-your-asset or simply come back to us in ⁠😅│general and we will help you out.

the verify is sending ADA transaction

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: verify-your-nft  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in verify-your-nft to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of verify-your-nft or simply come back to us in │general and we will help you out.

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: verify-your-nft  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in verify-your-nft to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of verify-your-nft or simply come back to us in │general and we will help you out.

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: verify-your-nft  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in verify-your-nft to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of verify-your-nft or simply come back to us in │general and we will help you out.

Verify Instructions 
1. Type: /verify add 
2. Press enter 
3. In the command line you will be prompted for your wallet address.

7. Copy this EXACT amount.

10. Wait for roles to drop.

Also, don't forget to ⁠2│verify-your-asset 

1. Go to your wallet holding your NFTs and make sure they are delisted (not put up for sale)
2. In your wallet, click 'receive', there you get your wallet address, copy your address.
3. Go to: ⁠2│verify-your-asset  and type '/verify add' followed by your wallet address, paste it after typing '/verify add'. Don't hit enter after typing that, it all has to go in 1 go.
4. The bot should notify you that you added your wallet address and will tell you to send a specific amount of ADA. This transaction has to be made from the wallet you just copied the address from, to that same wallet. So you send it to yourself.
5. If that went well, the bot should notify you again and then all you have to do is wait 1-30 min.

If you didn't receive the role(s) after 45+ minutes, you can assume something went wrong or it failed. Type '/verify list' in ⁠2│verify-your-asset to see the current status, '/verify unlink' to make sure your wallet is unlinked and can start over. Then start from step 1 again.

NOTE: If you've already verified on an other server, all you need to do is link your wallet. To do so, use '/verify link'.

If there is anything unclear, check the channel description of ⁠2│verify-your-asset or simply come back to us in ⁠😅│general  and we will help you out.
